subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What identity should iOS treat as stable for a CA-trusted Remote Domain endpoint whose valid leaf certificate may vary between connections?
rationale: Certificate leaf pinning, CA-chain trust, and authenticated gateway-identity continuity provide different security and compatibility guarantees; source inspection cannot choose that product security boundary safely.

options.title: CA trust plus gateway identity
options.body: Use system CA validation and authenticated gateway-identity continuity for Remote Domain routes, retaining explicit leaf pins for self-signed or operator-pinned endpoints.

options.title: Support multiple certificate pins
options.body: Retain certificate pinning but store and manage an approved pin set, which may still be fragile for externally managed anycast certificate fleets.

options.title: Keep strict leaf pinning
options.body: Continue rejecting any changed leaf certificate and document Cloudflare-style rotating edge endpoints as unsupported.

recommendation.title: CA trust plus gateway identity
recommendation.body: Use system CA validation and authenticated gateway-identity continuity for Remote Domain routes, retaining explicit leaf pins for self-signed or operator-pinned endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects the current iOS gateway connection, trust-prompt, and reconnect workflow where this contributor has substantial adjacent history.
